review_method: Full-document semantic review in an isolated same-family synthetic reviewer context, plus aggregate mechanical checks. No detector, score, detector source, development error list, or earlier blind corpus accessed. Gold consumed only in-memory by aggregate overlap code.

semantic_review.fictional_identity_context: Author-supplied fictional personal identities, no public-figure references observed; coincidence with real people cannot be excluded.
semantic_review.prose_consistency_disposition: Minor synthetic narrative/format inconsistencies do not change the unambiguous student-code ground truth and were left unchanged under fix-only rules.

mechanical_checks.normalization: NFKC, casefold, Thai-digit conversion, whitespace/punctuation removal; phone country-code canonicalization; birth-date calendar canonicalization.

gold_overlap_aggregate_only.earlier_blind_overlap_check: Not performed; earlier blind corpora not accessed.

diversity.template_similarity_method: Pairwise character SequenceMatcher ratio after replacing annotations with type tokens; autojunk=False. Descriptive only; not a statistical independence test.
diversity.assessment: Varied administrative and narrative contexts and multiple formats exist, but generated value patterns and limited name/address/contact pools remain conspicuous. Long-form documents share much framing and repeated filler. Negative documents often explicitly disclaim PII and are constructed look-alikes, not naturally sampled negatives. These limits constrain generalization and effective document independence. No diversity rewriting was performed under fix-only review.

tooling_guideline_alignment.explanation: The initial validator matched 13-digit substrings inside allowed longer tokens. The parent corrected its digit boundaries to implement the published maximal-token guideline, with regression checks. No corpus edit or detector-informed adjudication resulted.

limitations: Same-family synthetic author/reviewer process; no independent human agreement, cross-family review, or real-world distribution estimate.
Mechanical validity and semantic inspection cannot prove annotation completeness or real-person nonexistence.
Repeated components and long-form framing reduce diversity and may reduce effective sample independence.
Minor prose inconsistencies were retained because they do not violate annotation rules; no aesthetic or difficulty edits.
No detector/scorer execution; no performance claims from QA.
